Head-sha: 910dbebc9f71858b95c71fbc54b30b066f3bb911

L1 read of #34665 for #34608 (2026-11-17T06:13Z). Merge-base 97defd60, 3 commits, 58 files, +2037/−1192. Both must-fix items below can be answered with comments, without a new push. I will re-read on this same head once they are posted.

## Must-fix

**M1. The claim's file surface does not cover 13 changed files.** The code-PR surface in claim 6937569040 is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/**`, `ui/apps/console/src/**` (it names AiChatPage, HomeLayout, HomePage and AppManagementPage there), the locale packs and `.changeset/`. Three of those four named files actually live in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/**`, not in `ui/apps/console/src/**`. The amendments 6939362908 and 6939618290 widen only the ADR PR. These files are outside the code-PR surface:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/`: `AiAddressRedirect.tsx`, `AiChatPage.tsx`, `ConversationsSidebar.tsx`, plus `__tests__/AiAddressRedirect-34608`, `AiChatPage.appContextComposer-11658`, `AiChatPage.draftsBarInFlow-12978`, `AiChatPage.planApprovalReachesLaunchers-11666`, `ConversationsSidebar.test`, `editModeEmptyState.test` (9 files)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeLayout.tsx`, `HomePage.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674.test.tsx`

The os-dev-report lists them as deviations, but the seat still has to post a claim amendment naming `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` and that chrome test. The amendment should also correct the path of the three named files.

**M2. Acceptance items 1 to 4 have no live readings.** The new tests are real and they pass. But in jsdom they only check class names and testids. They can't show that `fixed inset-0 z-40` really fills the window inside the real `AppShell` (ancestor overflow or transform, z-order against the top bar, the preview bars and Radix layers). They also don't cover the cold-boot path behind an old link. The card states each acceptance item as something a user does (#34656 was held to the same standard). Please post readings from a booted console on this head, with screenshots under `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34608-live/`:
1. On an opportunity list: `location.href` before the robot click, the drawer visible after it, and `location.href` unchanged. Click again and it closes. No floating button anywhere.
2. Press Expand: the panel's `getBoundingClientRect()` equals the viewport, and the history column is visible. Press Restore: it returns to the rail width. At rail width, the History button opens the list and picking a row shows that thread.
3. Inside an authorable app, as a user with build permission: the empty state's description and its first two suggestions are data questions.
4. Open `/_console/ai/build/<a real conversation id>` in a fresh tab: where it lands, and that the full-window drawer shows that conversation.
5. A phone viewport: the bottom sheet opens from the robot, and its History button works.

## Should-fix

**S1. Say what happens to the drawer's thread when you move to another app, and include it in the readings.** The target is per tab, and "a target never infers the app" (A3). So once a history row or "Edit with AI" has pointed the drawer at app X's build thread, moving into app Y keeps X's thread, with `context.packageId` = X while `surface` is Y's page. Before A3, A2 bound the in-app dock to the app in view. This may be intended, but the maintainer will read the PR, not the code. Add one line to the PR body's acceptance notes, and add one reading: open a row bound to X, go to app Y, and record what the chip and the empty state name.

## Notes

- **Tier H by size.** `check-governed-merges --pr 34665`: 0 of 58 paths on the register, 3229 changed lines > 3000, so it needs a human merge or an authorized approval. After ACCEPT it goes to the seat for the approver request. The code cites ADR PR #34640 (Amendment A3), so that one should be approved first or together with this.
- **Conflict with #34628** in `ConsoleLayout.tsx` (known). Merging main forward after #34628 lands owes a delta read.
- **What I checked and found in order:**
  - A3 "Addresses" against `parseAiAddress`: `/ai`, `/ai/:agent`, `/ai/:agent/:id`, `?package=`, `?new=` and the older `?agent=` are all handled. `?new=` keeps the old presence semantics (`searchParams.get('new') !== null`, AiChatPage line 1230 on main).
  - The three `/ai` routes sit outside both layouts, so the host remounts after the redirect and reads the stored target.
  - The handoff rides only navigation state, and the host drops it with a same-page `replace`.
  - The only `navigate(` calls left in the dock path are the same-page replace, the redirect, and `useOpenAssistant`'s fallback outside a host. Deleting `aiEntryAsksUnsaved-13253` is consistent with that, because maximize no longer leaves the page.
  - No e2e spec references the floating button, `chat-dock-maximize` or the `/ai` pages.
  - Print still hides `chat-dock-panel`, so the full-window layer does not print.
- **Changeset.** It names `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`, the three packages whose src moved. I read it sentence by sentence against the diff, including "The URL does not change", the History button on the phone sheet, "`?package=` and `?new=`" and "Retiring them is a separate change". It matches.
- **i18n.** 5 new keys in all 11 packs. zh-Hans: 历史 / 返回对话 / 展开 / 还原为侧边栏 / 「问数据，或者让我改这个应用 —— …」. That matches the card's wording. en is present, zh-Hant was regenerated, and no key was removed. The Clause-② widening covers locale keys only, so per the seat's routing this is L1 at TIER_DEFAULT with no L2. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so the new `index.ts` exports are not a published face.
- **Card items 1 to 6** are each implemented: robot toggle and no floating button; in-place full window with the same `<aside>`; history button and column; builder guidance; Home hosts the drawer; Home and app-management entries plus the `/ai` redirect. Studio's copilot maximize still navigates to `/ai/build?package=…` and so lands on Home. A3 assigns that to #34610, so it is correctly out of scope here.
- **Leftovers for a follow-up cleanup card** (the filer's call, not this PR): the print selector `[data-testid='console-chatbot-fab']` in `styles.css` and its row in `print-stylesheet-4462.test.ts`, the `data-fab-yield` attributes, the `unsavedEditsLeave.census-13253` docblock that names the deleted suite, the unread keys `console.ai.dock.maximize` and `console.ai.empty.editApp.description`, and the unrouted `AiChatPage`.
- **Check-runs on 910dbebc:** 58 runs and none red. Test UI 16/16 shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard all succeeded. The rest were skipped by the path filter. The test and gate commands in the body are real commands with their output; the full app-shell suite was not run locally, and CI's 16 shards cover it.

## Live readings on 910dbebc (answers L1 6940375394, M2 and S1)

Head-sha: `910dbebc9f71858b95c71fbc54b30b066f3bb911`
Read at: 2026-11-17T06:37Z

**Rig.** The real console (`ui/apps/console` Vite dev server) over a real CRM example boot (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`, after a full `pnpm build` of this head): real auth, metadata, sessions and the opportunity list. Only `/api/v1/ai/**` is a stand-in, because service-ai is Cloud/EE and the open framework answers it 501. The stand-in serves the agent catalog (`ask`, and `metadata_assistant` with authoring capability) and an in-memory conversation store seeded with two threads. Signed in as `admin@objectos.ai` (a builder). Chromium, 1440×900 desktop and an iPhone 13 profile. Script, raw readings and 18 screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34608-live/` (`live-readings.mjs`, `readings.txt`, `readings-s1c.txt`).

All five acceptance readings match the card.

**1. Robot toggles the drawer on the opportunity list, address unchanged.**
- `location.href` before: `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity`. Drawer visible before: false.
- After the robot click: drawer visible, rect `{x:1020, y:48, w:420, h:852}` (the rail under the top bar). `location.href` unchanged.
- Second click: drawer gone, `location.href` unchanged.
- No floating button anywhere: no `position: fixed` button or link in the document, before or with the drawer open.
- Shots `1a`, `1b`, `1c`.

**2. Expand and Restore; History.**
- Expand: panel rect `{x:0, y:0, w:1440, h:900}` = the 1440×900 viewport. The element at the top bar's position (centre, y=20) belongs to the panel, so it sits over the top bar. History column visible beside the chat, rect `{x:0, y:44, w:288, h:856}`. Address unchanged. Shot `2a`.
- Restore: rect back to `{x:1020, y:48, w:420, h:852}`, identical to the rail before.
- At rail width, History opens the list (shot `2b`). Picking "How many open opportunities?" closes the list and shows that thread's answer; the address stays unchanged (shot `2c`).

**3. Empty state in an authorable app as a builder** (CRM, package `com.example.crm`).
- Title "Editing “CRM”".
- Description: "Ask about this app’s data — counts, lists and summaries — or tell me what to change, and I’ll modify the app in place: a field, an object, a view or a dashboard."
- Suggestions, in order: "List the 5 most recently created records.", "Count records for each object.", then the four change starters. So the first two are data questions. Shot `1b`.

**4. An old link, cold, in a fresh tab.**
- Opened `/ai/build/conv_build_crm` in a new tab, which has its own sessionStorage. It landed at `/home`.
- The drawer is `data-full-window="true"`, rect = viewport, and shows that conversation (its seeded answer is visible). Tab target `{"agent":"build","conversationId":"conv_build_crm"}`. Shot `4`.
- The `/_console` prefix is the production basename; the dev server mounts at `/`, so the path read here is the same route without the prefix.

**5. Phone (iPhone 13, 390×844).**
- The robot is on the top bar. Tapping it opens the bottom sheet (`chat-dock-mobile-sheet`, rect `{x:0, y:100, w:390, h:564}`), with the address unchanged.
- The sheet's History button shows the list. Picking a row shows that thread.
- Shots `5a` to `5d`.

**S1. Moving from app X to app Y.** This is now an acceptance note in the PR body.
- (a) A history row picked inside CRM gives target `{"agent":"build","conversationId":"conv_build_crm"}`. A row names no package, because the server stores none on a thread. So the chip reads "New app". After moving to Setup, the drawer stays open on the same thread with the same chip. Shots `s1a`, `s1b`.
- (b) A target that names a package (the drawer's app switcher, the "Edit with AI" shape) is `{"agent":"build","packageId":"com.example.crm"}`. In CRM it reads "Editing “CRM”" with chip "CRM". After moving to Setup it still reads "Editing “CRM”" with chip "CRM". Shot `s1c`.
- (c) With no target, the ambient thread follows the app in view. CRM shows "Editing “CRM”" with chip "CRM". Setup, a built-in app that is not authorable, shows "Build with AI" with chip "New app". Shot `s1d`.

So a target follows the tab and never re-binds to the app in view; only the ambient thread does. That is A3's "a target never infers the app". The PR body's acceptance notes now say so, and say which of A2's behaviours remains (the ambient thread only).

**M1** (claim surface) is the seat's amendment; nothing pushed. The head is unchanged: `910dbebc`.

It adds `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674.test.tsx`. All 58 changed files are now inside the claimed surface.

**M2, met.** Live readings are in comment 6940782559, taken on 910dbebc. They come from the real console over a fresh CRM boot with real auth and metadata. Only `/api/v1/ai/**` is a declared stand-in, because service-ai is Cloud/EE and open source answers 501. I read `readings.txt`, `readings-s1c.txt` and the screenshots `1b` and `2a` in `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34608-live/`:
1. The robot on `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity` opens the rail at `{x:1020, y:48, w:420, h:852}`, and `location.href` does not change. The second click closes it. No `position: fixed` button or link exists before or after.
2. Expand gives `{0, 0, 1440, 900}`, which equals the viewport. The element at the top bar's position is the panel, and the history column is `{0, 44, 288, 856}`. Restore returns to the same rail rect. At rail width, History plus picking a row shows that thread. The address never changes.
3. In CRM as a builder: "Editing “CRM”", the data-and-change description, and the first two suggestions are data questions.
4. `/ai/build/conv_build_crm` in a fresh tab lands at `/home` with `data-full-window="true"`, at viewport size, showing that conversation.
5. On an iPhone 13 the robot opens the bottom sheet with the address unchanged, and History plus picking a row works.

This answers my concern about the fixed layer inside the real `AppShell`: it covers the whole window, top bar included, and its own header carries Restore and Close (shot `2a`).

**S1, met.** The PR body's acceptance notes now say that a target follows the tab and never re-binds. A row (no package) keeps its "New app" chip across apps. A package-naming target keeps "Editing “CRM”" in Setup. Only the ambient thread follows the app in view. Each case was read live (s1a to s1d). This is A3's "a target never infers the app". The maintainer can see it in the body.

**Check-runs on 910dbebc.** The 58 runs read in my first pass are green. The body edit re-triggered Check Changeset, which was `in_progress` at read time. The changeset file did not move, but it must be green again before any approval-to-queue step.

- The `ConsoleLayout.tsx` conflict with #34628 stands. Merging main forward after #34628 lands owes a delta read.

### 维护者速读（终稿）

- 改了什么：AI 助手只剩右侧抽屉一个容器。顶栏机器人在当前页开关抽屉，URL 不变；右下角浮动按钮去掉。「放大」是原地铺满窗口（左侧多一列历史），同一个按钮收回。Home 也用同一个抽屉；Home 的「用 AI 搭建 / 问 AI」和应用管理的「用 AI 编辑」改为打开抽屉。旧的 `/ai`、`/ai/build/<id>` 链接（含分享链接）打开抽屉并铺满、显示链接指向的会话。
- 为什么改：#34608 的裁定「同意」（6937495221）；ADR 依据是同批交审的 #34640（ui ADR-0057 A3）。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台前端（app-shell、console、i18n 新键），不动元数据、契约和服务端；`/ai` 路由保留。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`layout/useConsoleChatDock.tsx`（开关、放大、目标、快捷键）、`layout/ChatDock.tsx` 的 `ChatDockPanel`、`console/ai/AiAddressRedirect.tsx`；实机读数和截图见评论 6940782559（验收 1–4 与手机抽屉均符合）。
- 两分钟验证：PR 正文「两分钟验证」的四个测试文件全过。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（3229 行，超过 3000 行人工合并线；不触受管路径），请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 审批，建议与 #34640 一起看、先批 #34640。L1 ACCEPT 评论 6940813452 在 Head-sha `910dbebc` 上；只增 i18n 文案键、app-shell 为工作区私有包，无契约面，不欠 L2。

席位意见：建议批准。已知后续：本 PR 与 #34628（手机底部菜单栏，已在合并队列）在 `ConsoleLayout.tsx` 冲突，#34628 先落，本 PR 再合一次 main，L1-b 读 delta；#34610 已从本分支起步开发，本 PR 合并后开 PR。

## 席位核对

- 形态：`Fixes #34608`；app-shell layout / console/ai / console/home、console App 路由、i18n 11 个语言新键、patch changeset；`Clause-②: yes`（仅 i18n 文案键）、`Metadata-protocol: none`。
- 前提实测：卡线程在启动的 CRM 控制台上实读验收 1–4 与手机抽屉（6940782559，截图在项目文件 objectstack-seat3/34608-live/）；跨应用会话行为（S1）三种情况实读并写入正文。
